title: Reranking retrieved candidates

thumbnail.alt: Video thumbnail for Reranking retrieved candidates

children.text: Retrieve broadly, then rerank precisely. A reranker reads query and passage together, which is why it beats vector distance on ordering.
What this lesson covers
Retrieve a wide candidate set, then narrow it
Score query and passage jointly with a reranker
Balance the latency cost against the accuracy gain
This lesson sits in Retrieval Quality, part of Retrieval-Augmented Generation from Scratch. It assumes what came before it and leads directly into the next lesson in the module.

keyPoints: Retrieve a wide candidate set, then narrow it
Score query and passage jointly with a reranker
Balance the latency cost against the accuracy gain

title: Evaluating retrieval

children.text: Before blaming the model for a bad answer, check whether the right passage was ever retrieved. Recall at k tells you which half of the system to fix.
What this lesson covers
Build a query set with known correct passages
Measure recall and precision at k
Separate retrieval failures from generation failures

keyPoints: Build a query set with known correct passages
Measure recall and precision at k

title: Grounding answers with citations

thumbnail.alt: Video thumbnail for Grounding answers with citations

children.text: An answer the user can verify is worth far more than a confident one. Carry identifiers through retrieval so every claim can point back to a source.
What this lesson covers
Instruct the model to answer only from context
Thread source ids through to the rendered answer
Make citations clickable back to the original

title: Handling the no-answer case

thumbnail.alt: Video thumbnail for Handling the no-answer case

children.text: The hardest behaviour to get is a clean "I don’t know". Make it an explicit, allowed output instead of the model’s last resort.
What this lesson covers
Detect when retrieval returned nothing relevant
Make abstaining an explicit, acceptable outcome
Offer a next step instead of a dead end
This lesson sits in Grounded Generation, part of Retrieval-Augmented Generation from Scratch. It assumes what came before it and leads directly into the next lesson in the module.

keyPoints: Detect when retrieval returned nothing relevant
Make abstaining an explicit, acceptable outcome
Offer a next step instead of a dead end
proTip: An empty state that points somewhere useful beats a fabricated answer every single time.
